## Learning Goals {background-color="#1B4332"}

*Objectifs d'apprentissage*

By the end of today, you can:

- Explain what heritability (h²) actually measures, and why a trait
  needs it to respond to selection (the breeder's equation, R = h²S)
- Distinguish two different reasons selection can fail to change a
  trait: low heritability vs. an unfavorable correlation/trade-off
  with another trait
- Describe heritability of floral volatiles and what it reveals about
  the microevolutionary potential of floral scent
- Connect short-generation experimental evolution (pollinator-driven
  selection) to what heritability predicts should (or shouldn't) happen
